title: The gate fails on two tools no document named, and skips a third the same way
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: `env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/local/go/bin make check` reported `FAIL golangci-lint` beside `SKIP npm is not installed`. CONTRIBUTING.md now names both linters with the pinned version CI installs, and the cs-ledger install line beside the ledger paragraph.

details:
CONTRIBUTING.md tells a contributor to run `make check`, and says "A gate that cannot run here reports SKIP and still exits 0". `scripts/check.sh` runs `golangci-lint` and `deadcode` beside gofmt and vet on purpose. Its comment says "a gate that quietly skips is one nobody notices has stopped running", so a machine without them gets FAIL rather than SKIP. No document named either tool or how to install it.

The ledger gate is the documented behaviour: absent `cs-ledger`, the script skips it and prints the `go install` line. That line was in the script and in no document, so an agent routed to the ledger doctrine by AGENTS.md could not find where the tool comes from.
